title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review Poland's Sejm passed a sanctions bill Friday that lets the interior minister freeze bitcoin and bank funds of people on a national list, and a court appeal would not pause the freeze. This post Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
